snippet.title: The Ice Cream Culprit FULL Game Walkthrough / Playthrough - Let's Play (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
The Ice Cream Culprit By Konayachi All Endings Visual Novel Game Part 1 to Ending [Microsoft Windows]

Let your girlfriend know (or not) about the culprit who ate her ice cream.

The Ice Cream Culprit: https://konayachi.itch.io/the-ice-cream-culprit
Developer: Konayachi
Genres: Visual Novel
Platforms: Microsoft Windows

0:00 Ending 1 - She never found out. Good for you.
2:50 Ending 2 - You're busted. That's what you get from stealing.
5:59 Ending 3 - She accepted that she ate it. All is good.
8:42 Ending 4 - She accused you of eating it. It's probably your fault.
